import sys, json, random, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from fuzz import gen_trace
rng = random.Random(99)
traces = [gen_trace(rng, "t%d" % i, 200) for i in range(3)]
doc = json.dumps({"version": 1, "traces": traces}).encode()
outs = []
for seed in ("0", "1", "12345"):
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONHASHSEED=seed)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/app/submission/entry.py"], input=doc,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
    outs.append(p.stdout)
print("deterministic:", len(set(outs)) == 1, "len", len(outs[0]))
open('/workspace/tmp/big.json','wb').write(doc)
EOF
